sources.name: A comprehensive dataset of magnetic resonance enterography images with bowel segment annotations
sources.cohort: patients with inflammatory bowel disease, 2019-2023, single centre; 1600-2000 mL of 2.5% mannitol per MRE
sources.modality: coronal T2 HASTE (fast spin echo) 0.35-1.5 T abdominal MRI
sources.metadata_source: Zenodo REST API https://zenodo.org/api/records/13839321 fetched this run; cohort/label/modality details from Sci Data 10.1038/s41597-025-04760-z

constrains.mechanism: per-segment luminal content volume of cecum/ascending/transverse, descending/sigmoid and rectum gives the volumetric scale of the three model compartments; a gas/liquid split inside the segment is not available

sources.caveats: label volumes are distended luminal CONTENT (fluid + gas), the model's v0 is a residual GAS volume; mannitol distension and an IBD population both differ from the model's healthy reference case. Scale bracket only.
sources.verification: downloaded and parsed this run; see sample section

sources.name: Dataset with segmentations of 117 important anatomical structures in 1228 CT images (TotalSegmentator dataset v2)
sources.size_human: 23.6 GB (single .zip); a 102-subject subset is offered separately by the depositor
sources.format: CT volumes + NIfTI multi-label segmentations, 117 classes, class 20 = colon
sources.cohort: random sample of routine clinical CT at University Hospital Basel, mixed scanners, contrast and pathology
sources.access: anonymous HTTPS for the record; per-case extraction is constrained by the 23.6 GB single-zip layout
sources.metadata_source: Zenodo REST API https://zenodo.org/api/records/10047292 fetched this run; class list from github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator

constrains.mechanism: whole-colon lumen label in a large general population gives colon volume and calibre distribution, i.e. the geometric scale and population spread that the assumed v0 and compliance values should be compatible with

sources.caveats: the colon class is a single lumen label; it does not measure wall stiffness, so compliance can only be bounded by the geometry, not identified
sources.verification: metadata read from the repository this run; no case downloaded (23.6 GB exceeds the run's transfer budget)

sources.name: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task10_Colon (colon cancer primaries)
sources.size_human: 6.24 GB image tar (126 labelled training volumes + 64 unlabelled test volumes)
sources.format: NIfTI (.nii.gz) portal-venous CT with tumour label; oriented to RAS with fslreorient2std, radiological NIfTI standard
sources.cohort: patients undergoing resection of primary colon cancer, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, heterogeneous scanner protocols
sources.access: anonymous HTTPS from the AWS Open Data mirror; Accept-Ranges: bytes verified this run
sources.metadata_source: HTTP HEAD on the image tar this run; counts, license and framing from Antonelli et al., doi:10.48550/arxiv.2106.05735 and medicaldecathlon.com

constrains.mechanism: supplies a third, tumour-bearing CT cohort in an explicit RAS frame, usable to check that any colon geometry model reports its coordinate frame and scale consistently

sources.caveats: the label is the tumour, not the lumen or the wall, so it constrains nothing directly; label archive URL Task10_Colon_labels.tar returned HTTP 404 on this mirror this run, so the label path is UNKNOWN
sources.verification: URL and byte count verified by HEAD this run; no volume downloaded

sources.name: Colonic high resolution manometry (ex vivo human distal colon)
sources.size_bytes_basis: UNKNOWN exactly; the page prints '400.83 MB'. The decimal reading 400830000 B is not asserted as an exact byte count.
sources.size_human: 400.83 MB (98 files), as printed on the dataset page
sources.format: plain .txt pressure traces (PlotHRM layout) + a subject demographics manifest in the primary folder
sources.cohort: entire sections of surgically excised human distal colon; organ-bath motility recordings; demographics in a manifest file
sources.modality: high-resolution manometry, pressure in mmHg vs time
sources.access: anonymous download, isAccessibleForFree=true (page JSON this run)
sources.metadata_source: dataset page HTML fetched this run (license creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/, isAccessibleForFree true, DOI 10.26275/zdxd-84xz, size string 400.83 MB)

constrains.mechanism: measured intraluminal pressure amplitudes, contraction durations and propagation directions give the pressure scale over which the model's gas-conductance terms and valve threshold can switch on, and the amplitude/frequency that motility_gain is meant to scale

sources.caveats: ex vivo tissue on a bath, so it constrains wall/pressure conduction and contractile pattern, not in vivo gas flow; no gas species, no subject-level compliance curve
sources.verification: license, free-access flag, DOI and size read from the page this run; 98 files / 95 records are as listed on the page

sources.name: Hydrogen and Methane Breath Test Data in CIPO and Healthy Controls (Japan)
sources.size_human: 19.0 kB xlsx (plus citation.txt 708 B, README.txt 6.6 kB)
sources.format: xlsx, one row per subject per time point; H2 and CH4 in ppm, age/min in minutes
sources.n_subjects: UNKNOWN from the deposit; cohort is CIPO plus healthy controls, study period April 2019 - March 2022
sources.cohort: congenital portosystemic shunt / CIPO patients and healthy controls in Japan
sources.modality: breath H2/CH4, device BGA2000D, 50 g oral glucose load, sampling every 15 min from 0 to 120 min
sources.metadata_source: Zenodo REST API https://zenodo.org/api/records/16910802 fetched this run; protocol and device from the record README

constrains.mechanism: a serial breath time course after a fixed substrate dose gives the production time constant and the shape of the dose response; the concurrent CH4 column separates H2 production from methanogenesis, which is the split the model's microbial sink has to reproduce; the breath arm bounds the blood-to-breath leg

sources.caveats: a 2 h horizon after a 50 g glucose load is a small-intestinal test; it does not measure colonic content transit, dissolved gas, or rectal outflow, and the substrate differs from the model's 15 g lactulose
sources.verification: record metadata read this run; file not downloaded (it is the same schema as DS6)

sources.name: Lactulose Hydrogen-Methane Breath Testing for Clinical Characterization of Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth in Adults with Functional Bloating
sources.format: xlsx, serial breath measurements with symptom scores
sources.cohort: adults with functional bloating, cross-sectional; 42 of 90 breath-test positive (24 H2-positive, 12 CH4-positive, 6 mixed)
sources.modality: breath H2/CH4 after a lactulose load, serial sampling over 120 min
sources.metadata_source: Zenodo REST API (record 20578412 redirects to 20578413) fetched this run

constrains.mechanism: same mechanism as DS5 on a lactulose substrate, which is the model's own substrate, so the dose axis is directly comparable with lactulose_g = 15 g

sources.caveats: 90 min horizon, small-intestinal end point, single centre; no colonic sampling, no rectal gas, no dissolved gas
sources.verification: record metadata read this run; file not downloaded

sources.name: Transit time (supporting Table 1) - wireless motility capsule, healthy controls vs FGDS
sources.format: xls, one sheet 'Table 1', 7 x 6 cells, one row per GI segment
sources.n_subjects: UNKNOWN - group sizes are not in the deposited table
sources.cohort: healthy controls and familial glucocorticoid deficiency syndrome (GUCY2C) patients
sources.modality: wireless motility capsule transit times, hours
sources.metadata_source: figshare API https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/5453194 fetched this run; file downloaded and parsed this run

constrains.mechanism: measured gastric, small-bowel, colonic and whole-gut transit times bracket the total residence time the three assumed compartment time constants must sum to

sources.caveats: median-of-transit-time, not the mean residence time of a serial compartment chain; no per-colonic-segment breakdown in the deposit, so the three taus cannot be separated by this file alone; the FGDS group is a monogenic constipation cohort, not a healthy reference
sources.verification: downloaded and parsed this run; see transit_evidence

sources.name: UW-Madison Serial Abdominal MRI Collection (GI Tract Image Segmentation)
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (dataset manuscript); Kaggle dataset usage policies apply to the files
sources.size_human: UNKNOWN - repository landing page reports counts, not bytes; not fetched this run (authentication required)
sources.format: 16-bit PNG per axial slice + CSV contour annotations; DICOM-RT segmentations converted to CSV
sources.cohort: 107 radiotherapy patients on a 0.35 T MR-Linac, 2015-2019, 1-5 serial volumetric abdominal MRIs each (467 scans)
sources.modality: MRI, mostly 144 axial slices at 1.5 x 1.5 x 3 mm
sources.access: Kaggle account required - NOT anonymously downloadable
sources.metadata_source: Data in Brief doi:10.1016/j.dib.2024.111159, retrieved via web search this run; repository not fetched directly

constrains.mechanism: the only listed source with repeated same-patient imaging on separate days, so it is the natural dataset for the between-day variability of luminal content volume that the assumed v0 values currently hide inside a single constant

sources.caveats: large-intestine label only (no sub-segments, no rectum label stated), 16-bit PNG in a non-DICOM frame requiring the provided loader, requires an account, byte size UNKNOWN
sources.verification: described from the dataset manuscript; bytes and license file NOT verified at the repository this run
